jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Armed Mobile Patrol Specialist in Houston, TX. This part-time role involves safeguarding clients across various industries, with a schedule including Friday and Saturday night shifts.

You will perform armed patrols, respond to incidents, and help with access control and customer assistance, contributing to a safe environment for shoppers and staff.

jobs.title: Armed High-End Retail Security Specialist
jobs.description:
St. Moritz Security Services, Inc. is seeking a Commissioned High End Retail Security Officer for the River Oaks District (Houston Regional Office). The role focuses on observing, reporting, and patrolling to ensure a secure environment for clients and visitors.

Pay is $18.50 per hour with a schedule from Thursday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The position is full-time and requires a valid license/permit, plus strong customer service and reporting skills.

jobs.title: Armed Entry Control Officer — Career Growth & Benefits
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Houston, TX is seeking an Armed Entry Control Security Officer to monitor government site access, verify credentials, and maintain a respectful, safe environment for clients and visitors.

You will conduct patrols, respond to incidents, document activity, and work a schedule that includes evenings and weekends. Applicants must have relevant security experience, an armed guard card, and meet age and background screening requirements.
